$schema_note: NSGA-II algorithm configuration, matching main.py's run_optimization(). Two named profiles are provided: 'demo' (fast, used for iterative development) and 'ps1_full' (the population=100/generations=200 setting PS1 suggests for a final, converged run). Switch profiles via the 'active_profile' field.

demo.purpose: Fast iteration during development and live demos. NOT the settings used for final reported/submitted numbers.
demo.typical_runtime_note: Completes in well under a minute on a standard laptop for this problem size.

ps1_full.purpose: Full-scale run per PS1's suggested settings. Should be run before treating Pareto-front/knee-point results as final for submission.
ps1_full.invocation_note: main.py has this as a documented one-line commented-out call inside run_optimization() -- uncomment / swap the profile to use it.

operators.notes: This config file does not override pymoo's NSGA2() default operator settings (e.g. eta_crossover, eta_mutation, prob_crossover) -- those remain at pymoo's library defaults unless explicitly tuned. Document any future tuning here.
